name: backend-request-flow-lab
description: An interactive visualization of distributed backend request tracing and troubleshooting.

scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n bff,api,orchestrator,worker "tsx watch services/bff/index.ts" "tsx watch services/application-api/index.ts" "tsx watch services/orchestrator/index.ts" "tsx watch services/worker/index.ts"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && mkdir -p dist/server dist/.openai && cp server/index.js dist/server/index.js && cp .openai/hosting.json dist/.openai/hosting.json
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:services
